Class PostReplyValidator

java.lang.Object
recognizers.PostReplyValidator
public class PostReplyValidator extends Object

Title: PostReplyValidator Class.

Description: This class evaluates whether a post or reply satisfies the input validation requirements for the Student Discussion System. It checks that the title and body are not empty and do not exceed their maximum allowed lengths, and it checks that thread management actions are restricted to staff members.

    • checkForValidThreadName

      public static String checkForValidThreadName(String name)

      Method: checkForValidThreadName(String name)

      Description: Validates a thread name before a create or update operation. The name must be non-null, non-blank, and at most MAX_THREAD_NAME_LENGTH characters.

      Parameters:
      name - specifies the thread name to validate
      Returns:
      an empty string if the name is valid, or an error message otherwise

    • checkForValidThreadDescription

      public static String checkForValidThreadDescription(String description)

      Method: checkForValidThreadDescription(String description)

      Description: Validates a thread description before a create or update operation. Description is optional (null or blank is allowed), but must not exceed MAX_THREAD_DESC_LENGTH characters if provided.

      Parameters:
      description - specifies the thread description to validate
      Returns:
      an empty string if the description is valid, or an error message otherwise

      public static String checkForValidThread(String thread, ThreadList threadList)

      Method: checkForValidThread(String thread, ThreadList threadList)

      Description: Replaces the hardcoded-name version above. Checks whether the specified thread name exists in the live ThreadList rather than a fixed set of known names.

      Parameters:
      thread - specifies the thread name to validate
      threadList - specifies the current list of threads to look up against
      Returns:
      an empty string if the thread exists, or an error message otherwise

    • checkForValidParameter

      public static String checkForValidParameter(String name, double maxScore, double weight)

      Method: checkForValidParameter(String name, double maxScore, double weight)

      Description: Validates the fields of an EvaluationParameter before a create or update operation. Name must be non-empty; maxScore must be positive; weight must be in the range 0.0-1.0 inclusive.

      Parameters:
      name - specifies the parameter name to validate
      maxScore - specifies the maximum score to validate
      weight - specifies the weight to validate (must be 0.0-1.0)
      Returns:
      an empty string if all fields are valid, or an error message otherwise

    • checkForValidAdminNotes

      public static String checkForValidAdminNotes(String notes)

      Method: checkForValidAdminNotes(String notes)

      Description: Validates admin notes before closing a request. Notes must be non-empty so that the admin documents what action was taken.

      Parameters:
      notes - specifies the admin notes to validate
      Returns:
      an empty string if the notes are valid, or an error message otherwise
